question: Why do the cats feel stylistically detached from the Godot game world?
main_judgment: Environment uses large simplified warm forms and broad color areas; cats retain realistic anatomy and dense high-contrast markings. Small game-camera presentation and weak/incorrect physical contact amplify the difference. All three cats exhibit parts of this mismatch; it is not confined to the new asset.
confidence_note: Art priority is qualitative judgement, not a measured contribution percentage. No appearance ablation experiments were performed in this analysis.

verified_facts.materials: Room and all three cats use StandardMaterial3D; room roughness .92, cats .90; no normal maps, material AO maps or emission enabled. Room uses vertex colors; cats use 2048 textures.
verified_facts.geometry: Room GLB totals 3002 base triangles including garden; new cat 3500. Triangle counts are not normalized visual-detail scores. Existing catworld visible body 12296 and Tripo body12300.
verified_facts.renderer: Godot Mobile/Metal; warm directional key energy1.7, ambient .58, fill .35; Filmic tone mapping.
verified_facts.reflection_transfer: Runtime metallic_specular reports .5 for all compared materials. New GLB declares KHR_materials_specular factor .3, but parameter spaces are not assumed numerically identical. No Godot specular-isolation test yet.
verified_facts.contact: Imported asset retains prior measured foot contact/skin deformation failures; controller only grounds REST bounds, not every animated support phase.
verified_facts.scale: New cat normalizes full REST AABB height to .43; raised tail contributes to extrema. This does not calibrate anatomical shoulder/head height across cats.
verified_facts.simulation: No per-cat stride calibration, foot IK, multi-cat avoidance or furniture navigation added. Existing overlap seen in demo.
verified_facts.reference: cat.png is a large near-view studio-style AI reference; it does not specify a unified room/character gameplay-scale art direction.

ranked_findings.finding: Large designed room surfaces versus dense fur/marking/cut-plane details in a small cat silhouette.

Black-white-orange edges and dark eye contours attract attention repeatedly across the body; the room uses broad warmer midtones. Being a readable protagonist is useful, but high-frequency contrast competes with form readability.

Room uses thick simple beams, clean planes and toy-like rounded furniture; cats retain fine anatomical muzzle, eyes, toe, ankle and body transitions. Natural cat proportions must not be discarded merely to match a cartoon room.
Overview makes cat details subpixel/small; full-AABB scaling includes raised tails and is not a general anatomical calibration.
Shared lights do not guarantee cohesive authored albedo or grounded paws; existing pose errors and incomplete local contact cues can create a composited-on-top impression.

Roughness is already close. Detailed albedo survives the no-light diagnostic. Some apparent shading may be baked into source imagery, but true pigmentation and baked illumination have not been separated. Cross-engine specular influence remains unisolated.
Foot contact, turning, stride/world-speed matching, deformation and lack of avoidance can make an otherwise attractive static cat feel disconnected while moving.

workflow_gaps: Independent acceptance of character and environment without a shared full-game visual target.
Treating low-poly/triangle budget and operational engine tests as sufficient progress without a separate world-cohesion gate.
Judging most appearance changes in a neutral close-up instead of the main gameplay camera.
Using complete bounds as body-size/ground-contact semantics.
Verifying a Blender material adjustment without corresponding isolated Godot visual validation.
No representative coat/body set for automated style/identity validation.
proposed_next_diagnostics_not_executed: Same-camera neutral gray-material comparison to isolate shape and scale.
Hold geometry/light fixed and compare semantically protected coat abstraction, preserving identity landmarks and eye/nose regions.
Hold asset fixed and compare contact/shadow settings supported by the target renderer; separate pose penetration from shadow bias.
Validate appearance at overview and interaction zoom, standing/walk/sit, then across black/white/tabby/calico and varied body types.

shared_specs: surface shading and runtime material contract
world units and anatomical size conventions
per_cat_derived: semantic coat regions and protected identity marks
body size from reliable anatomical landmarks rather than tail extrema
support phases and foot contacts from validated rig semantics
not_proven: automatic semantic simplification preserving identity on unseen cats
quantitative score that substitutes for art review

probe_caveat: Initial headless run had a 64x64 viewport; probe was rerun in the normal Metal display at1280x960 before inspecting camera data. Static mesh AABBs are not skinned geometry/contact measurements.
